The 'Visible numbering on back' was correctly marked untestable due to occlusion. While the placket is visible, distinct buttons are not clearly resolved, which is a minor alignment deviation.

I am upgrading the severity of the hand/bat artifact to 2.5 due to the combination of visual fusion and pose uncertainty.
